article.title: India Wins ICC Cricket World Cup 2025 — Beats Australia by 6 Wickets
article.description: Team India clinched the ICC ODI World Cup 2025 at Eden Gardens, Kolkata. Rohit Sharma's blazing 134* and Bumrah's 4/32 sealed a historic 6-wicket win before 68,000 fans.
article.author: Harsha Bhogle

article.title: Neeraj Chopra Shatters World Record with 92.5m Javelin in Zurich
article.description: Neeraj Chopra broke Jan Zelezny's 20-year world record with a stunning 92.5m throw at the Zurich Diamond League, becoming the first Indian to hold a track and field world record.
article.author: Atanu Das

article.title: Praggnanandhaa Becomes World Chess Champion at 20 — Beats Carlsen
article.description: R. Praggnanandhaa defeated Magnus Carlsen in a dramatic 14-game match to become the youngest World Chess Champion in history. India now holds both the Men's and Women's World Chess titles.
article.author: Viswanathan Anand

article.title: Mumbai Indians Defend IPL 2025 Title in Super Over Thriller
article.description: Mumbai Indians captured their sixth IPL title in a Super Over final against RCB. Hardik Pandya's 68 runs and 3 wickets earned him the IPL 2025 Most Valuable Player award.
article.author: Sunil Gavaskar

article.title: FIFA Awards India Hosting Rights for 2027 U-20 World Cup
article.description: FIFA awarded India the 2027 U-20 Football World Cup. Six stadiums across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Hyderabad, and Guwahati will host 52 matches in India's second FIFA youth World Cup.
article.author: Sunil Chhetri
